placements.link_name: Sportsbook platform, odds compilation and liability management
placements.role: Sportsbook operator running a proprietary online gaming platform built in-house since 2014, with a third-party risk and trading platform from Kambi Group plc integrated into its online sports betting product. One of 4 vertically-integrated operators counted on this link (Rush Street Interactive, DraftKings, Bally's, Caesars), each counted for running its own in-house plumbing rather than selling a platform to others; Kambi is this link's only third-party platform vendor.

role_evidence.claim: Rush Street Interactive's proprietary online gaming platform has been developed and is operated in-house, and a third-party risk and trading platform currently provided by Kambi Group plc and its subsidiaries is integrated into its online sports betting platform.
role_evidence.source_name: Rush Street Interactive, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
